selectionBasis: Fourth cohort, selected only from RouteGadget event-list metadata (rg2api.php?type=events: name, date, club, type, suffix and world-file coefficients A-F) before downloading or viewing any image. Five regions and six clubs never used before (Glasgow STAG, Edinburgh EUOC and ESOC, Leeds AIRE, Manchester MDOC, Newcastle/Northumberland NATO), all outside Hertfordshire, London, Bristol and Oxford. Weighted toward Dashahe-like first maps of new places: hilly urban parks, a campus sprint and a university/urban area, plus two woodland stress cases. Eligibility: suffix gif (the verifier fetches kartat/<mapid>.gif), non-zero world file A-F whose origin lies in the event's region (several servers carry placeholder world files near 49.78N 7.56W, which were excluded), map id not shared with another chosen event. Reasons come from the event name, club, date and world-file scale plus public knowledge of the named place, not from any image. No outcome-based replacement is allowed.
referencePolicy: World files frame a bounded teacher viewport only and measure the result afterwards. Preserve every result including refusals and wrong fits.
